name: Tennessee Eastman Reactor Temperature (XMEAS11)
description: Reactor temperature in the Tennessee Eastman chemical process. Checks whether temperature stays within safe reaction limits to avoid runaway or quench.

elements.name: Reactor Temperature
elements.description: Continuous reactor temperature measurement (variable 9 in TEP dataset, XMEAS(9) in original Downs-Vogel notation, relabelled XMEAS11 in Rieth et al. 2017 dataset). Statistics from fault-free training data.

uncertainty.source: Tennessee Eastman Process fault-free dataset (Rieth et al. 2017, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/6C3JR1). XMEAS11 column from d00.dat fault-free training set (500 samples, 3-min intervals). Published histogram analyses confirm near-Gaussian distribution with mean ~120°C and tight std.

elements.name: Maximum Safe Reactor Temperature
elements.description: Upper operating limit for reactor temperature. Exceeding triggers fault IDV(7) — reactor temperature runaway — as documented in TEP fault catalogue (Downs & Vogel 1993).

consistency_relations.upr_description: The reactor temperature sensor reading is propagated directly (identity mapping) to the safety constraint domain. The measured temperature corresponds one-to-one with the physical state, and the uncertainty set must remain within the safe operating region below 122.9 °C without any scaling or offset.
